esp32.detail: 7 pins wired; U2.RST → D25 (GPIO25). U2.SLP → D26 (GPIO26). U2.STEP → D27 (GPIO27). U2.DIR → D13 (GPIO13). Added a separate 12 V supply for VMOT (it needs 8.2–45 V and up to 2 A, more than the board can give); its − joins the board's GND. Added the drv8825.py driver written from the datasheet.
Holds RST and SLP high, steps 200 forward (DIR high) then 200 back (DIR low): passes
